items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017

ctx.x: Both, but we found that we could salute this and salute that and do the songs and do the Sophie Tucker stuff, whatever, Dixieland, and still put out a quality product. And we got a lot of applause for that.
I’ve often had a hard time describing to someone, or to my own self, the difference, if there is any, between Dixieland and trad and Chicago and classic.
